title: Executive Employment Agreement: Vice President of Sales, Western Region - Quillfeather Analytics, Inc.
fictional_notice: All parties and facts are invented.

defects.title: Nine-month bar on working for listed competitors
defects.why: Exhibit B, section B-2 bars the executive from taking employment with or serving any Listed Competitor for nine months after termination. A noncompete in an employment contract is void no matter how narrowly tailored, and it is unlawful to include one.
quotes: During the nine (9) months that follow the Termination Date, Executive shall not accept employment with, or provide sales, sales management, consulting or advisory services to, any Listed Competitor, whether in the Western Region or elsewhere in North America.

defects.title: Covenants made enforceable under North Carolina law regardless of where the executive lives or works
defects.why: Exhibit B, section B-5 says the covenants are governed by North Carolina law and enforceable in any court regardless of where the executive resides or where the agreement was signed, and has her agree not to argue otherwise. A contract void under the chapter is unenforceable regardless of where and when it was signed, and the employer may not try to enforce it.
quotes: The covenants in this Exhibit B shall be governed by North Carolina law and shall be enforceable by the Company in any court of competent jurisdiction regardless of where Executive resides or works and regardless of where this Agreement was signed or performed.

defects.title: North Carolina governing law and exclusive North Carolina forum for a California-based employee without counsel
defects.why: Sections 12.1 and 12.2 apply North Carolina law to all employment claims and require suit exclusively in North Carolina, with a waiver of any California forum, while the recitals state that the executive lives and works primarily in California and was not represented by counsel. An employer may not require such an employee to litigate California claims outside California or give up California law.
quotes: shall be governed by and construed under the laws of the State of North Carolina, without regard to any conflict of laws rule that would apply the law of another state

shall be brought exclusively in the state or federal courts located in the State of North Carolina, and Executive consents to personal jurisdiction and venue in those courts and waives any right to bring or maintain such an action in the courts of California or of any other state

defects.title: Executive bears required home office and regional travel costs
defects.why: Schedule 1, Part E makes the executive pay, without reimbursement, for a home office the position requires and for automobile travel in her territory. The employer must reimburse necessary business expenses and an agreement to waive that right is void.
quotes: Executive shall therefore bear, at her own cost and without reimbursement, all expenses of her home office (including internet service, mobile phone service, printing and office supplies) and all expenses of automobile travel within the Western Region, including mileage, fuel, tolls and parking.

defects.title: Vacation payout capped at forty hours, balance forfeited on termination
defects.why: Section 4.2 pays out no more than forty hours of accrued vacation at termination and forfeits the rest. An employment contract may not provide for forfeiture of vested vacation on termination; all of it is paid as wages at the final rate.
quotes: On the Termination Date the Company will pay Executive for not more than forty (40) hours of accrued and unused vacation, and any accrued balance above forty (40) hours will be forfeited.

defects.title: Return of a paid quarterly bonus on short-notice resignation
defects.why: Section 3.6 makes the executive give back the Quarterly Bonus already paid for the last completed quarter if she resigns on less than thirty days' notice, and lets the Company deduct it from final pay. An employer may not collect back any part of wages already paid.
quotes: If Executive resigns on less than thirty (30) days' written notice, Executive shall return to the Company the Quarterly Bonus paid to her for the most recently completed fiscal quarter, and the Company may deduct that amount from her final paycheck.

defects.title: Ban on discussing pay with other employees
defects.why: Section 13.6 requires the executive to keep her salary, bonus and equity confidential and not discuss them with any other employee. An employer may not require an employee to refrain from disclosing the amount of her wages.
quotes: Executive shall keep the amount of her Base Salary, Target Variable Compensation, Quarterly Bonuses and equity confidential and shall not disclose or discuss any of them with any other employee of the Company, including the members of her sales team.

defects.title: Earned, unpaid quarterly bonus payable only after a general release
defects.why: Schedule 1, Part D withholds a Quarterly Bonus already earned for a completed quarter until the executive signs a general release, and denies it if she declines. An employer may not require a release of a claim for wages due unless those wages have been paid.
quotes: the Company will pay that earned Quarterly Bonus only after Executive has signed and delivered a general release of all claims against the Company in the form the Company provides, and no such Quarterly Bonus will be payable if Executive declines to sign the release
